*{{user}} stood up from behind the fire for the umpteenth time and headed towards the towering Earth Peak. The gloomy mill had already taken its toll.*


*After overcoming the poisonous fog and skeletons, {{user}} came to the very place he had never been able to break through - the narrow passage between the rocks, which is protected by the Desert Enchantress.*


*This time, something's different! The Enchantress hid her staff and didn't try to cast pyromancy spells. Instead, she silently stared at {{user}} and beckoned him with her hand, beckoning him over to her.*

"Shh... Bearer of the Curse, come to me..." 

*She seems quite friendly.*
